characters.name: REBA REIN
characters.description: Väike oranž rebane, suurte teravate kõrvadega, kandmas väikest sinist vesti, saba on kohev ja valge otsaga. Tal on uudishimulik ja kaval, kuid sõbralik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike pruun orav, suurte ümarate kõrvade ja pikkade vurrudega, kandmas rohelist mütsi. Saba on pikk ja kohev, ta on alati rõõmsameelne ja energiline. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Mängutuba
locations.description: Cozy children's playroom with light blue walls, a soft green rug on the floor. There is a single large window on the back wall showing blooming spring trees outside. A low, small wooden table is in the center, and a red toy box is in one corner. Colorful simple drawings of suns and clouds are pinned to the wall. Warm, soft light fills the room. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Reba Rein, a small orange fox wearing a blue vest, and Orav Ott, a small brown squirrel wearing a green hat, are standing in a cozy children's playroom. They are looking at each other with happy, curious expressions. The room has light blue walls, a green rug, a wooden table, a red toy box, and drawings pinned on the wall. Outside the window, blooming spring trees are visible. Warm, soft light fills the room. Cartoon style.

Reba Rein and Orav Ott are still in the cozy playroom, standing next to the low wooden table. They are looking at each other, Rein is tapping his paw thoughtfully, and Ott has a wide, excited smile. They both look eager. The room has light blue walls, a green rug, a wooden table, a red toy box, and drawings pinned on the wall. Outside the window, blooming spring trees are visible. Warm, soft light fills the room. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott, the small brown squirrel wearing a green hat, is excitedly pulling out a few clean, clear drinking glasses of different sizes from the red toy box in the corner of the playroom. Outside the window, blooming spring trees are visible. Warm, soft light fills the room. Cartoon style.

The room has light blue walls, a green rug, a wooden table, a red toy box, and drawings pinned on the wall. Outside the window, blooming spring trees are visible. Warm, soft light fills the room. The room has light blue walls, a green rug, a wooden table, a red toy box, and drawings pinned on the wall. Outside the window, blooming spring trees are visible. Warm, soft light fills the room. The room has light blue walls, a green rug, a wooden table, a red toy box, and drawings pinned on the wall. Outside the window, blooming spring trees are visible. Warm, soft light fills the room. The room has light blue walls, a green rug, a wooden table, a red toy box, and drawings pinned on the wall. Outside the window, blooming spring trees are visible. Warm, soft light fills the room.
